clinical_problem: Manual vertebra identification is time-consuming in surgical planning
technical_challenge: Robust automated vertebral segmentation + anatomical labeling in complex anatomy
research_opportunity: Develop deep learning model for automated vertebra segmentation and C/T/L labeling
project_1_contribution: Fully automatic segmentation/labeling pipeline as drop-in planning module
why_important: Reduces surgeon planning time 30-60min; increases case volume
evidence_base: ExcelsiusGPS does limited auto-planning; surgeon feedback indicates planning bottleneck
next_steps: Integrate segmentation output into planning software; validate with surgeon feedback

clinical_problem: Current guidance systems fail or degrade significantly with severe degeneration/scoliosis/prior instrumentation
existing_competitor_solutions: Fluoroscopy verification + manual adjustment; limited guidance accuracy in pathological cases
technical_challenge: Robust deep learning under anatomical variations (scoliosis; severe degeneration; fusion; transitional vertebrae)
research_opportunity: Train models on pathological subset; develop domain adaptation for degenerative cases
project_1_contribution: Pathology-aware segmentation model with validated performance on fractures/degenerations
why_important: Expands surgical indication from 60% to 80%+ of spine cases
evidence_base: Clinical feedback from surgeons; published limitations in navigation literature
next_steps: Annotate pathological cohort from VerSe/CTSpine1K; train separate model; cross-validate

clinical_problem: Patient actual position differs from preoperative plan; current systems rely on pre-registration with no dynamic updating
existing_competitor_solutions: Fluoroscopy check-in at waypoints; manual trajectory adjustment; no real-time model-based adaptation
technical_challenge: Fast intraoperative segmentation from fluoroscopy/cone-beam CT to detect shift
research_opportunity: Enable intraoperative segmentation pipeline for real-time plan refinement
project_1_contribution: Lightweight model optimized for intraoperative imaging (fluoroscopy; cone-beam CT) for dynamic guidance updates
why_important: Reduces intraoperative trajectory corrections; improves safety margin
evidence_base: Brainlab iCT feature shows value but hardware-expensive; intraoperative re-registration is known challenge
next_steps: Develop lightweight model for fluoroscopy; validate inference speed <2 sec

clinical_problem: Different surgical approaches (minimally invasive vs open vs percutaneous) have different instrument requirements and anatomy constraints
existing_competitor_solutions: Pre-planned rigid trajectories; one guidance model for all approaches
technical_challenge: Instrument-aware segmentation modeling; anatomically-constrained trajectory recommendations
research_opportunity: Develop segmentation models that output instrument-specific constraint maps
project_1_contribution: Multi-task segmentation with instrument-specific trajectory feasibility scoring
why_important: Reduces instrument collision risk; improves minimal invasion feasibility
evidence_base: Minimally invasive spine surgery complication rates 5-10% with navigation; instrument conflicts known issue
next_steps: Develop multi-task model; create instrument-specific training sets from surgical videos

clinical_problem: Many surgical practices use older/lower-cost imaging (2D X-ray; low-dose CT; portable CT); current systems require high-quality imaging
existing_competitor_solutions: Limited guidance on degraded imaging; systems optimized for diagnostic-quality scans
technical_challenge: Domain adaptation to handle imaging variability; low-dose and limited-angle CT reconstruction
research_opportunity: Train robust models on artificially degraded imaging; evaluate cross-domain transfer
project_1_contribution: Domain-adapted segmentation model validated on low-dose CT; portable CT; multi-protocol imaging
why_important: Expands addressable market to smaller surgical centers; enables mobile surgical units
evidence_base: Published work shows domain shift is major limitation; low-dose CT is growing trend in OR
next_steps: Implement domain randomization; validate on low-dose dataset

clinical_problem: Different countries/hospitals have different protocols/anatomies; no standardized workflow
existing_competitor_solutions: Region-specific manual approaches; limited surgical knowledge transfer
technical_challenge: Develop multi-site multi-protocol segmentation model; evaluate cross-site performance
research_opportunity: Train model on multi-center data; publish protocol standardization findings
project_1_contribution: Validated multi-site segmentation model enabling workflow standardization
why_important: Enables international surgical collaboration; reduces training burden
evidence_base: Regulatory differences and anatomical variations create workflow fragmentation; standardization reduces errors
next_steps: Establish multi-site validation cohort; publish protocol paper

clinical_problem: Difficult anatomy (severe degeneration; scoliosis; anomalies) requires experienced surgeons; complication risk not predicted pre-operatively
existing_competitor_solutions: Surgeon expertise-dependent risk assessment; no automated prediction
technical_challenge: Develop anatomical complexity classifier predicting procedure risk and requiring experienced surgeon assignment
research_opportunity: Build model to predict case difficulty/complication risk from preoperative segmentation
project_1_contribution: Anatomy-based surgical complexity prediction tool guiding case assignment
why_important: Reduces complication rate in complex cases by assigning experienced surgeon; improves efficiency
evidence_base: Complication rate literature: 2-5% without navigation; higher in difficult anatomy
next_steps: Develop complexity classifier; validate against complication outcomes

clinical_problem: Tumor detection and treatment planning for spinal metastases requires multi-step segmentation
existing_competitor_solutions: Manual tumor identification; separate tumor/bone segmentation; limited treatment planning automation
technical_challenge: Develop joint vertebra + tumor segmentation model; output surgical plan with radiation/ablation targets
research_opportunity: Create multi-task model for vertebra + lesion segmentation with treatment planning outputs
project_1_contribution: Tumor-aware vertebral segmentation enabling integrated oncologic surgical planning
why_important: Enables fully automated treatment planning for spine metastases
evidence_base: ASCO guidelines recommend navigation for complex tumor cases; market opportunity
next_steps: Develop tumor annotation set; train multi-task model; validate treatment plan quality

clinical_problem: Pediatric anatomy is smaller/more variable; standard adult systems poorly calibrated; growing minimally invasive pediatric spine surgery
existing_competitor_solutions: Adult-focused navigation systems; pediatric adaptations limited
technical_challenge: Develop pediatric-specific segmentation model accounting for growth variation and smaller anatomy
research_opportunity: Train on pediatric CTSpine1K subset; evaluate performance on pediatric anatomy
project_1_contribution: Pediatric-tuned segmentation model enabling safe navigation in children
why_important: Emerging pediatric minimally invasive spine market; safety critical
evidence_base: Pediatric spine complication rates higher than adults partly due to navigation limitations
next_steps: Acquire pediatric dataset; train pediatric model

clinical_problem: Prior spine surgery with implants creates imaging artifacts; re-operation guidance is challenging
existing_competitor_solutions: Metal artifact reduction algorithms; limited segmentation around metal; often manual re-planning
technical_challenge: Develop segmentation model robust to metal artifacts; enable re-operation planning
research_opportunity: Train on metal-artifact-rich imaging; evaluate on post-fusion and instrumented cases
project_1_contribution: Metal-robust segmentation model enabling re-operative guidance
why_important: Re-operative spine surgery is growing market; safety-critical navigation need
evidence_base: Metal artifacts are known limitation in navigation; re-op complication risk
next_steps: Develop metal-robust model; validate on instrumented cohort
